title: RogueSpam
wikitext: '''RogueSpam''' filters out specific error messages that can be annoying during combat as a rogue, helping you maintain focus during fights. == Installation == '''Manual Installation Only''' # Go to the main page of the repository. # Click the '''<> Code''' dropdown and download the repository as a .zip. # Unpack the .zip and move the RogueSpam folder from RogueSpam_v1.6 into your Interface/AddOns directory # Restart the game. '''Note:''' * You can enable configuration options via Cosmos if installed. == Git Links == * [https://github.com/crazypoultry/Wow1.12.1_Addons_Collection '''(crazypoultry)'''] == Commands == {| class="fandom-table" !Command !Description |- |/roguespam or /rs |Shows help and current status |- |/rs enable |Enables RogueSpam |- |/rs disable |Disables RogueSpam |- |/rs toggle |Toggles RogueSpam on/off |- |/rs list |Lists current filters and their IDs |- |/rs add [message] |Adds a message to filter list |- |/rs remove [id] |Removes filter by ID |} == Preview == Help: [[File:RSH.png|border|frameless|380x380px]] Filters: [[File:RSF.png|border|frameless|280x280px]] == '''Error Messages Filtered''' == * RogueSpam filters out messages like: ** "Ability is not ready yet." ** "Not enough energy." ** "There is nothing to attack." ** "That ability requires combo points." ** "Your target is dead." ** "Another action is in progress." [[Category:Addon]]
